neighbours.label: A compound modifier naming the basis of an approach (evidence-based, patient-centered, historically informed, farm-to-table, physically based): 'X-based method'; plain adjectives in the same slot stay quiet
fire: Nurses are trained in person-centered care at this college.
The ensemble is known for its historically informed playing.
We take a data-driven, research-based approach to teaching.
The bistro has a seed-to-plate menu in summer.
Climate modellers now rely on physically based parameterizations.
The agency promotes evidence-based policy in schools.
Farmers use integrated pest control and science-based methods.
The school uses a learner-centered, inquiry-based curriculum.
quiet: Nurses are trained in the old building at this college.
The ensemble is known for its very loud playing.
We take a slow, careful approach to teaching.
The bistro has a short menu in summer.
Climate modellers now rely on very large computers.
The agency publishes school reports in spring.
Farmers use heavy tractors and new fences.
The school uses a printed, colourful textbook.

notes: Card: '-centered' x3, ' evidence' x3, '-based' x3, ' informed' x2, '-to' x2, 'M' x4 of IPM, 'istic' of mechanistic-empirical. Logit effect promotes ' approach', '-based', '-driven'. Probe: IPM 0.90, -based 0.86, farm-to 0.84, -centered 0.57, informed 0.48; 'evidence ... in court' 0.01, city center 0.01, 'was informed' 0.01, plain adjectives 0.01.
